```sql
WITH cumberland_county AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Cumberland County' AND border_type = 'county'
),
hotel_elevations AS (
  SELECT 
    pois.poi_name,
    pois.addr_city,
    pois.addr_state,
    ST_Value(
      rast,
      ST_Transform(pois.geometry::geometry, 4326)
    ) AS elevation
  FROM pois
  JOIN public.dem_us
    ON ST_Intersects(
      rast,
      ST_Transform(pois.geometry::geometry, 4326)
    )
  WHERE pois.tourism = 'hotel'
    AND pois.addr_state = 'ME'
    AND ST_Contains(
      (SELECT geometry FROM cumberland_county),
      pois.geometry::geometry
    )
),
lowest_hotels AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM hotel_elevations
  WHERE elevation IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY elevation ASC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state, elevation
FROM lowest_hotels;
```
